must_record_before_delete: a deterministic manifest of every selected regular file: relative path, allocated blocks, logical size, sha256, device/inode, and link count
the target/debug directory allocated-byte total and filesystem block size
the pre-prune aggregate retained-work size and the selected-path size
an assertion that every selected path remains below exactly target/debug and that no selected inode has a link outside that subtree
the cache-prune job command, scheduler receipt, exit status, and post-prune aggregate size
must_refuse: any active scheduler lease, build process, or current final-build output rooted in target/debug
a missing or changed selected file between manifest capture and deletion
a selected inode with an external hardlink
a measured post-prune headroom below 734003200 bytes

installed distribution evidence and hardlink endpoint
